repos_data.description: MCP server for virtual phone number verification - SMS activations for AI agents via Claude, Cursor, VS Code Copilot and more...
Official open-source MCP server for Meser 10, the Israeli email and SMS platform. Connect your account to Claude, Cursor or any MCP client....

repo_meta_data.description: MCP server for account verification: SMS verification, number rentals and matching-country proxies on carrier-issued mobile numbers. 40 tools, 2500+ services, 145+ countries. Works with Claude, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Cline, Zed, OpenClaw, Hermes and Continue.
